author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages

slides.title: Your cold chain breaks at the *handoffs*
What an *excursion* is
bullets: Any time product leaves its safe range, even for minutes
Excursion rate = loads with an excursion ÷ loads monitored

slides.title: Pallets *waiting* on a warm dock
bullets: Set a maximum dock time per pallet
Stage in the cold room, not the dock
Load only when the truck is at the door

slides.title: Loading a truck that isn't *cold*
bullets: Check the box reading, not the dashboard

slides.title: Every drop *opens* the door
bullets: Sequence drops to cut door openings

slides.title: The last freezer is the *weakest*
bullets: Check outlet freezer temperature every visit
Don't push more stock than it can hold cold
Rotate by expiry, oldest out first

slides.title: Log every *handoff*, not just both ends
slides.body: Save this for your next review.
